name: ANATOLY GOLDSTEIN
abstract: It is shown how multidimensional complex Hilbert space can be used as a convenient geometrical model explaining mechanism of direct voice mediumship. A specific model of experiences described in the biography of direct voice medium Leslie Flint is provided.
